resetData.title: Reset data
resetData.intro: Delete one section's data or everything. This cannot be undone. Always kept: the company, settings, admin accounts, the main depot and the lists (units, price tiers, sectors).
resetData.step1Q: {n} records from “{name}” will be deleted. Continue?
resetData.step2M: Everything listed will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. Enter your password to confirm.

clients.name: Clients
clients.desc: Deletes every client together with their sales, orders, returns and payments.

suppliers.name: Suppliers
suppliers.desc: Deletes every supplier together with their purchase invoices, returns and payments.

products.name: Products
products.desc: Deletes every product and category, plus all documents and stock that depend on them (sales, orders, purchases, transfers, counts…).

stock.name: Inventory / stock
stock.desc: Zeroes all stock and deletes transfers, stock counts and losses. Products stay.

sales.name: Sales
sales.desc: Deletes all invoices, delivery notes, tickets, client returns and payments, and zeroes client debts. Stock is not changed.

orders.name: Orders (commandes)
orders.desc: Deletes every order, whatever its status.

purchases.name: Purchases
purchases.desc: Deletes all purchase invoices, supplier returns and payments, and zeroes supplier debts. Stock is not changed.

transfers.name: Transfers
transfers.desc: Deletes every stock transfer between depot and vans.

expenses.name: Expenses
expenses.desc: Deletes every recorded expense. Expense types stay.

cash.name: Cash
cash.desc: Deletes the daily cash closings and client deposits.

tournees.name: Tours
tournees.desc: Deletes every planned and completed tour.

staff.name: Vans & drivers
staff.desc: Deletes every van, driver/salesperson account and device, with their van-bound documents (transfers, counts, tours…). Admin accounts stay.

all.name: Everything
all.desc: Deletes everything above at once and restarts document numbering.
